description: This file defines a grain class LoadGrain for Orleans framework, responsible for generating transaction load and collecting performance reports. It includes methods for starting transaction load, managing concurrent transactions, and reporting success or failure counts.

classes.name: LoadGrain
classes.description: A Orleans grain class that generates transaction load for benchmarking, tracks performance, and handles transaction execution.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Starts the transaction generation process with specified run parameters.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Returns the generated report if the generation task is complete.

methods.name: RunGeneration
methods.description: Handles concurrent transaction execution, timing, and report generation.

methods.name: ResolvePending
methods.description: Resolves a list of pending transaction tasks, updating the report with success/failure statistics.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a single transaction via the root transaction grain, with retry logic on failure.
